scope: Fixed native read-query transport and integration with the corrected structured command contract

tests.coverage: Injected transport/lifecycle tests and real local contract decoding; no native Linux execution

implemented: Allow only fixed identity, introspection and selected extended-command reads; no GetAll, unit mutation or SSH.
Use shared 18-second and per-query 2-second budgets, a 64 KiB output cap and reserved cleanup time.
Retain the owned process/selector handles before later setup and attempt all ordinary closes.
Preserve original and cleanup exceptions separately without returning raw error messages.
Check the caller-latched invocation and equal before/after identity records; do not retry failures.

independentReview.finding: Unenforced exclusive-reaping assumption: Popen.returncode alone does not prove an unreaped child or a genuine kernel exit status.
independentReview.disposition: Keep candidate inactive. Do not enable numeric group signalling or acceptance until ownership and status evidence are strengthened.

offlineWitness.mode: Injected lost ownership and synthetic ECHILD fallback, not a real kernel experiment

proposedCorrection: Establish an isolated exclusive-reaping context before spawning; reject unsupported ownership conditions.
Obtain real kernel exit status and treat missing ownership/status as failure, not zero.
Do not signal a numeric group if ownership cannot be established; still attempt all remaining resource closes.
Add exact-limit EOF, cleanup-only failure and ownership/status-loss cleanup regression coverage.
limitations: Python spawn and descriptor close still require an external hard-deadline envelope before native use.
Direct-child reaping does not establish whole-unit cgroup clearance.
Actual target introspection size, CLI option compatibility, typed JSON and native resource behavior remain unverified.
The prior four-item contract correction remains a separate completed local result; these new integration findings do not rewrite it.
Only this sanitized record is committed; private source, test fixtures and raw logs remain local.
